name: merge-risk
purpose: Rank the files in a change by how much a human should look at them before it lands.
corpus: One changed file, with its diff summary.

state_schema.diff_summary: the hunks, or a faithful summary of them
state_schema.role: what this file does in the system, in one sentence

blast_radius.instructions: How far do the effects of this change reach?

irreversible_path.instructions: Does the change touch something a revert alone cannot undo: data deletion, a migration, credentials, billing, or an outbound message?

criteria.true: it touches at least one of those

behaviour_change.instructions: Does this change what the software does, rather than only how it is written?

route.instructions: How should this file be handled before merge?

criteria.read_required: a human reads this file before it lands

blast_radius.above: a human reads this file before it lands
blast_radius.calibration: RE-MEASURED 2026-09-19 over ten stratified splits of the same 40 hand-labelled diffs (data/merge-risk.jsonl, 20 read-required / 20 test-doc-cosmetic, drawn from ~/src/conclave history). A SINGLE split does not establish this gate and two single-split runs disagreed: the first reported gate 1.11 at 80.0% holdout, a second query round on identical data reported 1.24 at 85.0%. Across seeds 0-9 the fit threshold is bimodal, 0.72-0.79 in three splits and 1.23-1.26 in seven, and holdout accuracy ranges 70-95% with a median of 85%. The gate is set to 1.23, the dominant mode. The previously shipped 0.86 sat between the two modes, which is the worst available position, and it came from an in-sample fit on 20 items that reported zero errors because it was never held out. Model answers vary run to run; data/merge-risk.scores.json freezes one round so the analysis is reproducible even though the instrument is not.
blast_radius.validation: held out: fitted on one stratified half and evaluated on the other, repeated over ten seeds
blast_radius.interval: per-split 95% Wilson lower bound ranges 0.481 to 0.764 across seeds 0-9; no single split establishes the gate, and n=40 is too small for a tight bound

irreversible_path.above: a human reads this file before it lands, whatever its blast radius
irreversible_path.calibration: CALIBRATED 2026-09-19 on 22 real file-diffs read and labelled by hand, drawn from droppy-code, conclave, yessirterm and this repo: 8 touching credentials or deletion, 14 not. Gate 0.40 gives 2 errors, both MISSES, no false alarms. The deterministic keyword flag that is fed into the state as `diff_touches` would be wrong on 7 of 22 by itself, including a test whose fixture contains `rm -rf /` to prove the addon system rejects it - the judgment scored that 0.17 and was right. The 2 misses are label drift on my side, not model error: I labelled 'touches credentials' as irreversible while the question asks whether a revert alone cannot undo it, and a keychain READ (0.13) and a trap deleting the script's own temp dir (0.05) are both reversible. The gate was not moved to absorb them. Unmeasured on the 40-diff conclave corpus because no diff touched an irreversible operation.
irreversible_path.validation: in-sample only; fit and evaluated on the same hand-read set, no held-out split
irreversible_path.interval: point estimate; no confidence bound computed

behaviour_change.calibration: CALIBRATED 2026-09-19 on 40 real file-diffs from conclave (data/merge-risk.jsonl). Fitted on 20-item fit half (optimal threshold 0.70, tie width 0.04, 100% fit accuracy), evaluated on 20-item holdout half (100% holdout accuracy, 20/20, 0 disagreements, Wilson lower bound 0.8389). Previous gate was 0.50.
behaviour_change.validation: stratified fit/holdout split: 20 fit items (10 true / 10 false), 20 held-out items (10 true / 10 false); holdout accuracy 100.0% (20/20)
behaviour_change.interval: 95% Wilson score lower bound: 0.8389 (holdout n=20, k=20)

notes: This pack ranks and flags. It never approves a merge: the tests and the build gate that, and a judgment that says 'looks fine' is not a passing test. The blast_radius gate is measured with a stratified fit/holdout split on 40 durable hand-labelled diffs from conclave: gate 1.11 (old gate 0.86), holdout accuracy 80.0% (16/20), Wilson lower bound 0.5840. behaviour_change gate is 0.70 (old gate 0.50), holdout accuracy 100.0% (20/20), Wilson lower bound 0.8389. irreversible_path cannot be exercised by this corpus (no destructive/irreversible changes in sample) and remains calibrated from its separate 22-item credential/deletion sample at 0.40.
